sampling_method: Stratified candidate sampling across conversation lengths, intent clusters, risk levels, and difficulty tiers
annotation_method: 100% manual human review across multi-turn conversational context

evaluation_policy.usage_restriction: Strictly reserved for evaluation and benchmarking; must NEVER be used for model training, few-shot prompt tuning, or retrieval corpus ingestion.
evaluation_policy.action_independence: Routing action (AUTO_HANDLE vs ESCALATE) is an independent operational policy decision governed by risk, resolution availability, and support boundaries, separate from intent classification.
